critical_analysis.browser_graph: Not in actual Vite manifest; no source import found
critical_analysis.reachability: No observed Vite execution path. Node local-file inclusion precondition does not establish browser file access. HTML new-window injection requires affected output API; none located in application source. Separate prebuilt assets/native clients not certified.
critical_analysis.minimum_fix: npm audit proposes jspdf4.2.1; incompatible with original ^2.5.1. No lock-only compatible critical fix. Needs separately approved major API/security migration.

critical_analysis.browser_graph: Neither installed dompurify nor installed mermaid emitted by current Vite graph
critical_analysis.reachability: Prototype-pollution prerequisite not exercised. VMEditor loads separate preserved public/js/mermaid.min.js; its bundled dependency identity is not proven by npm lock. Cannot treat installed audit as its version evidence.
critical_analysis.minimum_fix: nested exact2.3.5 cannot be raised with lock-only satisfying parent. Critical patched2.4.2 still leaves other sanitizer advisories. Requires separately approved parent/override or dynamic bundle security migration; no blind override.

release_gate: UNRESOLVED_RUNTIME_HIGH_AND_LEGACY_DYNAMIC_ASSET_REVIEW; no exploit certification. npm total alone is not deployment risk.

runtime_high_context.markdown-it/linkify-it: Markdown parsing is browser-executed in chat/editor; nested legacy versions remain affected by algorithmic DoS; adversarial payloads not exercised.
runtime_high_context.tinymce: Rich text editor/browser loaded in actual task detail; reported sanitization XSS paths require security regression and compatible upgrade analysis; not silenced.
runtime_high_context.@kangc/v-md-editor: Aggregate transitive advisories, not independent direct advisory. Dynamic Mermaid static bundle preserved unchanged; provenance/runtime sanitizer review remains required.
